186 tile files - 184 the area's tile lists name, 4 its fill lists, 80 laid, 1 of those named by no tile list; each with its definition followed through what it inherits, and the tile's doodad list (.tmd)
a definition that inherits carries nothing but the reference (annalithic's Tdt.cs); a .tmd is the tile's own doodads, found beside the .tdt or beside its template
